# ThePrecisionLab

> ThePrecisionLab is a trading journal for recording trades, reviewing strategy performance, and building consistent execution habits.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.theprecisionlab.in/): Product overview and feature information.
- [Sign in](https://www.theprecisionlab.in/login): Access an existing account.

## Product

ThePrecisionLab helps traders record trade details, classify execution quality, review statistics, and organize practice in separate backtest workspaces. Trading results and analysis are user-entered and are not financial advice.
